blind.description: A circular giant nest or primitive bedding made from woven wooden logs and branches interspersed with large animal bones, fastened together with olive-green cloth straps and strips of red hide or cloth. One side of the rim is adorned with a round green shield or medallion lashed to the structure. Inside the nest is a shallow depression lined with dark grey stones, loose golden-tan straw or hay, and torn red fabric or pelts. The model is rendered in a hand-painted/stylized fantasy art style with solid geometry, no detached hovering parts, and rests directly on the floor without a separate plinth or base.
blind.from_above: A circular ring of logs, bones, and green wrappings enclosing an inner bed lined with dark rocks, tan straw, and draped red rags or hides.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/4 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 1.5 ft tall); diameter is roughly 3.5 to 4 ft across.
